 s=s.replace('let reborrow_ashared_loans_symbolic_borrows_no_synth (span : Meta.span)','let reborrow_ashared_loans_symbolic_borrows_no_synth ?(include_endable = false) (span : Meta.span)',1)
 s=s.replace('reborrow_ashared_loans_symbolic_borrows span (Some loop_id) ~with_abs_conts','reborrow_ashared_loans_symbolic_borrows ~include_endable span (Some loop_id) ~with_abs_conts',1)
 return s
edit('interp/InterpJoin.ml',patch)
edit('interp/InterpLoopsFixedPoint.ml',lambda s:s.replace('InterpJoin.reborrow_ashared_loans_symbolic_borrows_no_synth span loop_id','InterpJoin.reborrow_ashared_loans_symbolic_borrows_no_synth ~include_endable:true span loop_id',1))
(root/'entry-repair-pins.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(changes=pins,scope='At loop fixed-point entry reborrow all immutable abstract loan inputs, including endable loans belonging to an enclosing loop. Uses original reborrow operation and continuation; no validity check removed.'),indent=2)+'\n')
